purpose: Exhaust the remaining major two-state thermal-parameter escape route after FEAS-01 by testing a preregistered discrete thermal envelope crossed with the complete FEAS-01 corrected-control grid, without selecting or identifying a best parameter set.

staged_execution.stage_1: Evaluate all 29,160 global M0 configurations on consumed hot-start test 71207063.
staged_execution.stage_2: If and only if one or more stage-1 configurations satisfy all frozen hot-start whole-trace and hot-region criteria, evaluate those surviving exact configurations on consumed cold-start test 71207062.

interpretation.zero_hot_survivors: The preregistered broad discrete M0 thermal/control envelope cannot satisfy the consumed hot-start evidence. Combined with CAL-01 bound pressure and FEAS-01, this is sufficient development evidence to reject further M0 tuning and authorize formal M0-to-M1 promotion without opening the M0 blind holdout.
interpretation.hot_survivors_but_zero_joint_survivors: Some M0 configurations can satisfy hot start but none generalize to the consumed cold start. Reject further M0 tuning and authorize M0-to-M1 promotion without opening the blind holdout.
interpretation.one_or_more_joint_survivors: M0 remains structurally viable on consumed development evidence. Do not promote M1; further independent boundary constraints are required before blind M0 execution.

outputs_allowed: unranked parameter min/max ranges among survivors

solver_policy.vectorized_batch_requirement: Use the same independent equations and frozen parameter values for every configuration. Verify pass/fail equivalence against scalar M0 execution at deterministic sample configurations before freezing conclusions.
